missable_note: Four trophies can be missed: 29 Fair Game (one-time animal), 33 Hot Together and 34 Retail Therapy (partner free-roam window), 37 Catch Me If You Can (VCIA access window). Make a manual save before each one. Every other trophy stays earnable after the story ends.
note: Built from the official trophy descriptions (Exophase — GTA VI trophy list). Play the stages in order: the story first, the missable trophies while their windows are open, then the open-world cleanup. The four missable trophies are flagged in stage 1 — miss one and the platinum needs a new playthrough.
sources: Exophase — GTA VI trophy list; PSNProfiles — GTA VI Trophy Guide; PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap

stages.name: Story first — and grab the missables
stages.text: Play Chapters 1 to 4 and the story missions in order; every chapter and mission trophy pops on its own. While you play, watch for the four missable windows: Fair Game (29) — save before the one-time hunt; Hot Together (33) and Retail Therapy (34) — do both while your partner is in free roam; Catch Me If You Can (37) — leave VCIA without a flight plan while airport access is open. Do those four the moment their windows appear, then finish the story.

stages.name: Character finales and strangers
stages.text: After the story, finish the five character strands — Andy, Kenton, Billy, Randy and Tyrone — each ends in a final mission. Then clear the eight stranger strands (25): question marks on the map, new ones appearing after each chapter. All of them stay open after the story ends.

stages.name: Activities and skills
stages.text: Try one of each activity type first (16) — it shows you where everything is. Then work the grinds: 250 stunts (15), gold on all 42 shooting-range challenges (17, the hardest activity trophy — leave it for when your aim is warm), drone races at all 14 spots (18), 20 different race wins (19), Cal's fishing challenge (20), one arcade game (21), all 18 meditation spots (28) and a full game of bowling (46).

stages.name: Collectibles and the map
stages.text: Work district by district: 3 collectible card sets (30), 100 WAiNK It photo spots (31), 100 discovered vehicles (35), all 52 areas of Leonida (42), all 8 garage properties (54) and 10 Scooter Bros registrations (55). The in-game checklists track each one, so you always know what's left in a district before you move on.

stages.name: Heists, robberies and chaos
stages.text: The fun stage: rob a jewelry store clean (39), crack all 5 bank vaults (40), hit an armored truck (41), rob one illegal operation per gang (43), down 5 enemies in one Combat Focus (36) and deal with the Rhinos (38). Fold in the small ones as you go — the Ocean Beach cocktail (44), the showroom smash (45), the partnership moment (47), a failed-then-won retry (49), the night event in the swamps (50) and a melee drive-by (51).

stages.name: Money and the final cleanup
stages.text: Launder $250,000 of marked bills (52) and spend $100,000 in the shops (53) — both fill up naturally during stage 5, so top them up now. Then clear the last 50 challenges (32) and the 500 tracked choices (48). Open Stats, see what 100% completion (14) still needs, finish it — and the platinum (1) pops with the last trophy.

title: Roadmap to the platinum
